context:
Treat compose `ports:` as the canonical host reachability source and adapter
defaults as the canonical service/container source. Replace matrix.py /
docker_assets.py literal tables with resolution against those sources without
collapsing distinct endpoint roles. Lock it with a CI drift test that
re-derives the facts and asserts equality within each role — the same shape as
the submit-classifier contract test.
description:
Outcome of a 4-round adversarial architecture review of the UAT layer
(tests/uat/). UAT maintains its own connection-truth table that duplicates
facts already owned by compose files and platform adapters, and the copies
can disagree silently.

- tests/uat/matrix.py:19-95 hardcodes PLATFORM_PORTS, PLATFORM_EXTRA_OPTS,
  LOCAL_MANAGED_PLATFORM_EXTRA_OPTS, and credentials (e.g. password=benchbox).
- SingleStore alone shows why the model must distinguish endpoint roles:
    * UAT hardcodes local Docker host reachability at 13306 (matrix.py:22)
    * compose maps ${SINGLESTORE_HOST_PORT:-13306} on the host to container port 3306
    * adapter credentials default to the service/container port 3306 (benchbox/platforms/credentials/singlestore.py:30)
- tests/uat/docker_assets.py:75 is yet another separate registry from matrix.py.

Failure mode: set SINGLESTORE_HOST_PORT (or change a compose mapping) and UAT
silently probes the wrong host port even though the adapter's service-port
default remains valid. A skipped-because-wrong-host-port platform looks
identical to a genuinely-down platform, so divergence quietly erodes the exact
coverage UAT exists to prove. This is the load-bearing fact a "lightweight
user-exercising" layer actually needs, and the one most certain to rot.

anti_patterns.dont: add a fourth registry to 'unify' the three
anti_patterns.why: derive from existing canonical surfaces (adapter defaults + compose)

anti_patterns.dont: collapse SingleStore's host port and service/container port into one value
hardcode the resolved SingleStore host port
anti_patterns.why: read it so SINGLESTORE_HOST_PORT overrides flow through

anti_patterns.dont: leave matrix.py and docker_assets.py as two registries
